agent.problem: Too many choices require guessing details that the earlier cards have not supplied or made inferable. Cards 4-5 ask for two unrevealed parts of Amaziah's report, cards 11-12 ask about Amos's background and then his occupation without a useful clue, and cards 7 and 19 add further blind detail guesses. Discovery questions make up about half of the stop, including two consecutive pairs, rather than remaining a few exceptions among mostly informed guesses.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
